data.bio: Paul was raised by his grandparents, who provided him with love and support throughout his childhood. He also received help from Tia Lucas and Tio Juan, who became important figures in his life. Despite not having traditional parents, Paul has built a strong family of his own with his three children: Luis, Carmen, and Suzette. He works as a social worker, helping children and families navigate difficult situations similar to his own background. Paul values the relationships he has with his children and the extended family that helped raise him.
